title: Become my Mindless Puppet
description:
In this file you will be hypnotized to become mindless. Empty. Blank.

You will fall under the sway of my words, and realise that you are no longer in control. That I am stepping inside your body and taking over. That I am rewiring your mind to obey and serve me. That you will do anything I command.

Before this file ends, you will lose all control. You will move at my will. Speak on command, and feel as though you’re a puppet on my hypnotic strings. You will become nothing more than my mindless zombie. And when it’s over, you will think you can escape.

But you’ll come back. You’ll crawl to me. And then you’ll know you’re mine.

This file involves some physical interaction. I recommend using wireless headphones and sitting, not lying down, for the full experience. If you prefer, you are welcome to visualise rather than moving your body.

This is a dark, dangerous file. It includes suggestions of longing, craving, shame, and addiction.
author: Mistress Calia
